title: Care Agent Adjustment Authority and Billing Dispute Lookback: Home Protection Plans
content:
Two figures govern corrections to Home Protection Plans fee lines: how far back a posted fee line may be corrected, and the largest refund a care agent may post.

| Plan | Billing dispute lookback (calendar months after posting during which a fee line may be corrected) | Largest refund a care agent may post (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Surge Shield | 12 | 60.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard | 12 | 60.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard | 12 | 60.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care | 12 | 60.00 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan | 12 | 60.00 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete | 12 | 60.00 |
| Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | 12 | 60.00 |

Both figures are uniform across the line: a lookback of 12 calendar months from the posting of the fee line, and an agent refund limit of $60.00.
